pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately rounded vertices and soft pixel-level gradients at the edges. Patch geometry on the neck is more elongated and rectangular, while patches on the mid-flank exhibit more complex, stellate outlines with varying spatial areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored cream pathways forming a continuous topological network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate. Pathway width is relatively uniform throughout the mid-flank and shoulder regions, providing a consistent negative-space contrast to the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane along the cervical and thoracic ridge. The silhouette displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated pattern against the background foliage, consistent with upright, stiff hair bundles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small cluster of dark, punctate focal points is visible on the posterior rump, suggesting possible localized skin disruption or the presence of ectoparasites.
